notes.title: Upcoming Full Release & Pricing Model Update
notes.content: [p][b]Dear early Tennis Life players,[/b][/p][p]Thank you so much for your support of [i]Tennis Life[/i]. As the full version of the game—featuring player development and club management elements—is approaching release, we are planning to change the game’s pricing model to Free to Play.[/p][p]This change will take place after the “Racing Fest” event ends next week.[/p][p]For our existing players, your access and gameplay rights will remain completely unaffected. The SenseDevil team is sincerely grateful for your early support![/p]

tags.feature: - This change will take place after the “Racing Fest” event ends next week.
